title: Spider burritos?
content: I was walking around my dream mall and was really hungry. I stopped at a Mexican stand that seemed sort of like a Chipotle because around the corner I could see the burrito building station with people dishing out delicious looking guacamole and pico de gallo. I ordered the latest trendy burrito. The person laid a tortilla directly on the counter and spooned some meat and sauce on it and handed me a packet. Apparently the gimmick was that you pour a packet of spider eggs onto the warm meat, which causes the baby spiders to hatch and start running around, and then you roll it up and eat it before they get away. I was so hungry I couldn’t wait for them to hatch, so I started eating the burrito with just the egg packet on it. It didn’t taste terrible. Kind of crunchy and citrusy. I just remember being a little disappointed that I didn’t get any guac or pico de gallo like the happy customers around the corner.
